mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% over the next 20 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% over 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE decreases > 0.5% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over 3 months signals increased demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where HOUST increases > 5% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over 3 months signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO decreases > 2% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is above 2% YoY, the combination signals a potential overheating economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over 3 months signals strong labor market conditions, boosting consumer confidence and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where PAYEMS increases > 200,000 over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Real final sales of domestic product (RSAFS) increasing by more than 3% YoY signals robust consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where RSAFS increases > 3% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4% signals a restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is above 4%.
